messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: New release 1.4.6
parts:
Dear All,

We have made a new release of the Subread package. See the link below for details:

http://subread.sourceforge.net/

The Bioconductor R package Rsubread was updated accordingly as well. The latest version can be found at:

http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/Rsubread.html

We are also delighted to report that our Subread-featureCounts-limma/voom pipeline was found to be one of the best-performing pipelines for the analyses of RNA-seq data by the SEQC/MAQC III Consortium. See the below paper published in Nat Biotech last month for the comparison results:

http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/25150838

We have also created a new Bioconductor package called 'seqc', which includes the read count data and exon-junction data generated by using our pipeline. You can download this package from the following link:

http://bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/html/seqc.html   (188MB)

All the best,

Wei
